documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report recommending denial of Warfield Companies' variance request from PEC District land use percentage minimums (Case 2025-03).
documents.description: BZA staff report analyzing the variance request against §180-105(A)(3) and §180-109 criteria. Staff finds no unique physical hardship, that reducing non-residential minimums conflicts with the PEC District's employment objectives, and recommends denial with a prepared resolution/order. Recommended motion is to deny and direct Board Counsel to prepare the necessary order for signature.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 03 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: Cover letter and formal BZA application for variance from PEC District land use percentages, filed September 5, 2025 by attorney David K. Bowersox on behalf of Warfield Companies.
documents.description: Application package including cover letter from Hoffman, Gomfort, Offutt, Scott & Halstad LLP, BZA Notice of Appeal and Application for Hearing form, certified list of contiguous property owners, and parcel/building ownership information for the five Warfield Companies entities. Bases for variance cited as Town Code Sections 180-22 and 180-105(3).

documents.name: Warfield Concept Plan with Variance
documents.synopsis: Concept plan drawing by Morris & Ritchie Associates (September 2, 2025) submitted with the variance application showing the Warfield property with proposed land use areas.
documents.description: Site plan exhibit depicting the Warfield at Historic Sykesville property (~90.57 acres) with proposed land use configuration under the requested variance. Prepared by Morris & Ritchie Associates and submitted as part of BZA Case 2025-03.

documents.name: Applicant Post Hearing Memorandum
documents.synopsis: Post-hearing memorandum filed by Warfield Companies after the initial BZA hearing on Case 2025-03.
documents.description: Applicant's memorandum submitted following the initial hearing, providing additional argument and information in support of the variance request for PEC District land use percentage adjustments.

documents.name: Town Lawyer Response Memorandum
documents.synopsis: Town's legal memorandum responding to the applicant's post-hearing submission, addressing variance criteria for BZA Case 2025-03.
documents.description: Memorandum prepared by Town counsel addressing the legal standards for variance approval and responding to the applicant's arguments in their post-hearing memorandum. Submitted for the February 11, 2026 continuation hearing.
